usedFor: Jotform holds form submissions, and Todoist turns each one into work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: Each answered form becomes a task with a title and details, so no submission waits unnoticed.

watchOut: “New Submission” can return a single-line no-data message instead of a submission, so test it before “Create Task”.
